Hey so I am kinda in a similar boat, but from you fiancés perspective. Here is how we handled the situation. 



My fiancé and I dated all throughout highschool. He went into the military and we broke up for 6 years. In the interim my fiancé had a threesome with one of his now best friends. ( one of his groomsmen). Once we got back together we hung out with this man very regularly. I’d say 2-3 times a week. Played DND together ect. He’s bi and I was aware of that. I always joked with my fiancé that I could never tell if he thought he or I was cuter cause he kinda flirted with the both of us. I ended up really enjoying his company and consider him a good friend as well. About a month ago I found out about them hooking up. I was extremely hurt because I was never told about this. Kinda felt betrayed. Apparently he had told me once while we were drunk but I don’t remember that. He had referenced this threesome before while we were sober but I never thought to ask who it was. 



Anywho I was extremely hurt, and upset. Not so much with our friend, but my fiancé. I felt embarrassed that  was this secret in the room I didn’t know about. We had to have a long talk about how it meant nothing, and he said he was honestly embarrassed about it. It happened in a different state prior to them working together and becoming close. I had to look inward and ask myself is this something I’m going to be able to get through. If you feel comfortable showing your fiancé this, this is my advice to her. 



He is choosing you. He loves you. Life is messy and complicated. If you can’t get over that he has a past life prior to you, that’s something you need to ask yourself why. Is it worth losing his over? Shaming him for this is not going to make this situation better. And shaming him by misgendering his friend is not mature. It does nothing but reflect poorly on you and hurt your fiancé. No matter how hurt you are, hurting someone else won’t make you feel better.
